study.question: Does the supplied full-block order benefit in the strongest joint model enter through the coarse linear summary, the orthogonal quadratic summary, or their interaction, at fixed learned capacity and measured cost?
study.hypothesis: The observed joint replacement loss is concentrated in histories long enough to occupy many blocks. Provisionally, a coarse linear coordinate may carry most of this supplied-order utility, while the quadratic coordinate adds departures from the linear trend. The previous experiment removed both together, so separate contribution and interaction remain unknown. Supplied positions have no assumed timestamp, elapsed-time or recency semantics. This study decomposes the existing feature family rather than asserting a new model mechanism or originality.

predictions: Linear-main-effect prediction: on supplied layout L1Q0 recovers more than half of the observed L1Q1-minus-L0Q0 click-AUC contrast0.0026443547431324 (recovery>0.0013221773715662), and exceeds supplied L0Q1. This is a prospective numerical prediction, not measured.

Order-specific prediction: supplied L1Q0 exceeds canonical L1Q0 by at least0.0005 AUC, while the incremental quadratic contribution at L1 is smaller than the linear contribution at Q0. AUC0.0003 is predeclared as a practical descriptive indifference band, not a statistical significance threshold.

If linear and quadratic are jointly necessary, both single-ordinal cells remain below supplied L1Q1 and the AUC interaction I=A11-A10-A01+A00 is positive outside the descriptive band; this alternative would revise the linear-dominance hypothesis.

Canonical cells should show smaller coarse-feature benefits than supplied cells if positions, rather than generic independent directional capacity, matter. More than one seed or authorized paired uncertainty is needed for repeated support.

All four new variants should have32192421 total,31793216 embedding and399205 dense parameters, like inspected endpoints; true native count is a readiness check. Work and inference latency should be close to r0056, with no speedup presumed.
falsifiers: The linear-dominance hypothesis fails if supplied L1Q0 restores at most half of the full contrast, or supplied L0Q1 exceeds L1Q0 by>=0.0003; report quadratic dominance, synergy or null effects as observed.

If both single-ordinal features help equally in canonical layout, a supplied-order-specific explanation is weakened; generic feature conditioning, retained block composition or arbitrary coordinate effects remain viable.

If no partial cell approaches the original and the interaction is large, a one-moment sufficiency claim fails; the joint pair may be necessary under this recipe. One unsuccessful replacement does not establish order is indispensable to every architecture.

Any unintended change to fifth summaries, tensor shapes, masks, event eligibility, initialization, optimizer/source gates or bridge outputs invalidates attribution and must be fixed before scientific scoring.

A one-seed gain without reproducible paired support stays preliminary; prediction-time permutation sensitivity alone is insufficient. A cheaper order-invariant trained replacement matching the original within the practical band in a later admissible contrast would falsify useful order dependence in that tested setting.
